nodes.label: Offscreen eye worker (offscreen.html)
nodes.rationale: Hidden page that only runs camera + MediaPipe.

nodes.label: active.ts activeExtractor switch
nodes.rationale: Single switch for live extractor; also breaks a circular-import crash.

nodes.label: StandardizedRidgeEstimator
nodes.rationale: Ridge penalises all weights equally; small-spread features like head pitch get deleted unless features are standardised first. Lambda moves to new scale (~10).

nodes.label: Validation.ts (leaveOneDotOut, chooseLambda)
nodes.rationale: Holds out whole dots because ~22 frames per dot are near-copies; training error is optimistic.

nodes.label: VerticalFullExtractor (26 features)
nodes.rationale: Comparison arm only; fits cal dots best but overfits.

nodes.label: VerticalLeanExtractor (13 features)
nodes.rationale: Recommended: generalises best on unseen dots.

nodes.label: Frame quality score (blink filtering)
nodes.rationale: Filtered at training time, not capture time, to avoid losing whole dots for narrow-eyed users.

nodes.label: Gaze pipeline (MediaPipe 478 landmarks -> features -> ridge -> screen pixel)
nodes.norm_label: gaze pipeline (mediapipe 478 landmarks -> features -> ridge -> screen pixel)

nodes.label: IrisRelativeExtractor
nodes.rationale: Measures iris relative to eye so head movement cancels out; 13 landmarks, 9 features.

nodes.label: More face landmarks, for vertical accuracy
nodes.norm_label: more face landmarks, for vertical accuracy

nodes.label: loadModel extractorName mismatch guard
nodes.rationale: Old 9-weight model with 13 features yields silent NaN predictions; guard refuses mismatched saved calibration.

nodes.label: Eye corners as vertical zero line (33/133, 362/263)
nodes.norm_label: eye corners as vertical zero line (33/133, 362/263)
nodes.rationale: Bone-anchored, does not move on blink; replaces eyelid as reference.

nodes.label: Eyelid openness as model feature / blink detection
nodes.norm_label: eyelid openness as model feature / blink detection
nodes.rationale: Lets regression subtract lid-droop bias; averaging three lid points cuts jitter.

nodes.label: Problem 1: eyelid ruler moves
nodes.rationale: Lid-to-lid denominator shrinks on squint/smile/downward look and goes to zero on blink; horizontal uses fixed eye corners so it does not suffer.

nodes.label: Face midline head-pitch estimate (10,168,1,152)
nodes.rationale: Ratio of upper-face to lower-face length is pitch estimate independent of forehead size; z depth gives second opinion.

nodes.label: Problem 2: no head-pitch signal
nodes.rationale: Looking down vs nodding down land in same place; nose height moves for both.

nodes.label: Problem 3: head roll leaks horizontal into vertical
nodes.norm_label: problem 3: head roll leaks horizontal into vertical

nodes.label: Iris ring as fixed ruler (469-472, 474-477)
nodes.rationale: Iris ~11.7mm in all adults, constant physical unit; apparent size gives head distance.
